clue.text: High quality pupils

definitions.meaning: ... as a noun means excellence or distinction, as in 'a player of real ...'
the group of pupils taught together

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses of one word: stylish excellence, and a school group taught together.

clue.text: God is getting gesture of respect, but giving curl of lip

parts.note: Cupid is the Roman god of love
is shortened to 's
a bow is a gesture of respect

explanation.surface: A deity is greeted with a bow but responds with a sneer.
explanation.definitionFit: Cupid's bow is the double curve of the upper lip.

clue.text: Answer at once, not having to cover up with this

indicators.note: not having means the word for to is dropped

parts.note: pronto means at once

explanation.surface: Respond immediately rather than having to hide.
explanation.definitionFit: An apron is a garment you put on to protect your clothes.

clue.text: Boast to English about the French stage production

indicators.note: about means the boast and English go around the French article

parts.note: to swank is to show off
la is French for the

explanation.surface: Someone brags to the English about a French play.
explanation.definitionFit: Swan Lake is Tchaikovsky's ballet, staged in theatres.

clue.text: Entertainment is baffling? In what way?

parts.note: to floor someone is to baffle them, so 'is baffling' gives floors
how? asks in what way

explanation.surface: Someone finds a performance bewildering and asks how it works.
explanation.definitionFit: A floor show is cabaret entertainment staged on a nightclub floor.

clue.text: Told illness went quickly

indicators.note: told means the word for illness is spoken

parts.note: flu is influenza, an illness

explanation.surface: Someone said they were ill and left in a hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: Flew is the past of fly, to move fast.

clue.text: Last in order, poor grade in exam, but honest

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the exam

parts.note: O level was the former British school exam taken at about 16
nth means the most recent of an indefinitely long series
E is a low exam grade

explanation.surface: A student came last with a weak mark but was truthful.
explanation.definitionFit: On the level is an idiom for honest and above board.

clue.text: Two hands hold up opera, as on spoke

indicators.note: hold means the two hand letters go around the opera

parts.note: R and L stand for right and left hands

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the opera's name reads upwards

parts.note: Aida is Verdi's opera

explanation.surface: Two workers prop up an opera production.
explanation.definitionFit: Radial describes lines running out from a centre, like wheel spokes.

clue.text: Ref coming on to pitch will enjo himself

definitions.meaning: a referee walking out carries the match ball
the paper prints enjo, a typo for enjoy; to enjoy oneself greatly

explanation.walkthrough: The newspaper printed 'enjo', a slip for 'enjoy'; read it as enjoy himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a ball is an idiom for having great fun; literally a ref holds the match ball.

clue.text: Triumph over establishment but look pained

indicators.note: over in a down clue puts the first piece on top

parts.note: to triumph is to win
CE is the Church of England, the established church

explanation.surface: Winning against the institution brings a grimace.
explanation.definitionFit: To wince is to flinch with a pained expression.

clue.text: This secretary is no temp

parts.note: a secretary who is not a temporary worker has a lasting post, the opposite of a temp

explanation.surface: An office boast that this secretary is staff, not agency.
explanation.definitionFit: A staff member who is not temporary holds a lasting, fixed position.

clue.text: Remove element of German nobility from part of England?

parts.note: de- is a prefix meaning remove, as in de-ice
von is the particle in German noble names

explanation.surface: A proposal to strip German aristocrats of their titles, set somewhere in England.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as an instruction, 'de-von' would mean taking the 'von' off a name; together the pieces spell the county.
explanation.definitionFit: Devon is a county in south-west England.

clue.text: Finally condemned old invader to hang

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word condemned

parts.note: the Angles were Germanic invaders of early Britain

explanation.surface: A condemned man is finally hanged, sentenced like an ancient raider.
explanation.definitionFit: To dangle is to hang loosely or swing suspended.

clue.text: Brought back to conscious state

indicators.note: back means the word for brought is read in reverse

parts.note: brought in the sense of led someone along
conscious means aware

explanation.surface: Someone is revived and brought round to full consciousness.
explanation.definitionFit: Delaware is named by example: it is one of the fifty US states, the first to ratify the Constitution.

clue.text: In March, review American philosopher

parts.note: a demo is a protest march
a crit is a critical review

explanation.surface: A US thinker's work reviewed in March.
explanation.definitionFit: Democritus was an ancient Greek philosopher, proponent of atoms.

clue.text: Hole out in six? Isn't losing

definitions.meaning: a golfer finishing a hole in six strokes beats, or breaks, a score of seven
neither gaining nor losing money overall

explanation.walkthrough: The same letters split differently: BREAK SEVEN for the golf score, BREAKS EVEN for the finances.
explanation.definitionFit: To break even is to finish with no loss and no profit.

clue.text: His curate organised it?

indicators.note: organised signals the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Did the vicar's assistant arrange the service?
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also defines: a curate might well organise Holy Communion.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eucharist is Holy Communion, a church service a curate would lead.

clue.text: Tree may need greasing

definitions.meaning: to grease someone's ... is to bribe them

explanation.definitionFit: A palm is a tropical tree, and the hand's inner surface that a bribe greases.

clue.text: Wrong emphasis, getting hooligan finally out of form

indicators.note: wrong signals the letters are put in a different order
finally picks the closing letter of hooligan

explanation.surface: Mistaken stress from a thug leaves him off his game.
explanation.definitionFit: Misshapen means deformed, lacking proper shape.

clue.text: Prostitute's "Leave it alone!" as bottom's pinched

definitions.note: read as prostitute is, the 's being the verb

indicators.note: pinched means the bottom is gripped inside the instruction

parts.note: stet is the proofreader's mark meaning let it stand
the rump is the bottom; the 's is is

explanation.surface: A sex worker protests when her bottom is pinched.
explanation.definitionFit: Strumpet is an old word for a prostitute.

clue.text: Vicious editor leaves for Northern town

indicators.note: leaves means the letters for editor depart from the word

parts.note: vicious means wicked

explanation.surface: A nasty editor quits for a job up north.
explanation.definitionFit: Wick is a town in Caithness in the far north of Scotland.

clue.text: The wealthy get their way in financial conference

definitions.meaning: the saying that ... means the rich have influence

explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says wealth brings power; read literally it is a discussion about cash.

clue.text: Decide not to retire from extremely smart area, yes?

indicators.note: extremely picks the first and last letters of smart

parts.note: yup is a casual yes

explanation.surface: A question asking if someone opts out of retirement from a smart district.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay up is to not go to bed, retire meaning to go to bed.

clue.text: Drab strip of wood taken by bird

indicators.note: taken by places the bird after the strip, as if it carries it off

parts.note: a slat is a thin strip of wood
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A dull lath carried off by a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Drab is an old word for a slovenly woman, the same sense as slattern.

clue.text: Russian special forces have halved

parts.note: the SAS is the British Special Air Service

indicators.note: halved keeps the first half of the word have

explanation.surface: Russian commandos are cut in two.
explanation.definitionFit: Sasha is a common Russian first name, so a Russian.

clue.text: What places conservative hardliners in first position?

definitions.text: What places conservative hardliners in first position?

parts.note: places means puts

indicators.note: in first position picks the opening letter of each of the two words

explanation.surface: A question about what brings right-wing extremists to the top.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also defines: a coup is a way hardliners seize first place.
explanation.definitionFit: A putsch is a sudden attempt to overthrow a government, often by extremists.

clue.text: Vicious city thus met fate: nothing escaped

parts.note: so means thus

indicators.note: escaped means the letter for nothing gets out of the word

parts.note: doom is fate
O is nothing, zero

explanation.surface: A wicked city got its comeuppance with no escape.
explanation.definitionFit: Sodom is the biblical city destroyed for its wickedness.

clue.text: Get good grasp of old author

parts.note: to hug is to hold tightly

explanation.surface: Get a firm understanding of a classic writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Victor Hugo was a French author, writer of Les Misérables.

clue.text: Reflective, quiet state absorbs one

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
I is the Roman numeral one
NY is New York, a US state

explanation.surface: A thoughtful, quiet region taking in one person.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiny surfaces reflect light.

clue.text: How the dead will finally be raised? False

definitions.text: How the dead will finally be raised?
definitions.meaning: at the Last Judgement a trumpet sounds and the dead rise, so they are woken by a trump

explanation.definitionFit: Trumped-up means invented or falsely concocted, as charges can be.

clue.text: Hating history, getting nought in course

parts.note: anti means opposed to, hating
the past is history
O looks like nought

explanation.surface: A student loathing history scores zero in the subject.
explanation.definitionFit: Antipasto is an Italian starter, the first course of a meal.

clue.text: Knight, cut out, is put back in part of Shakespeare

indicators.note: is put back means the pieces are written in reverse order

parts.note: N is the chess notation for knight
to cut out is to omit

explanation.surface: An actor playing a knight has his part cut from a Shakespeare play.
explanation.definitionFit: Timon of Athens is one of Shakespeare's plays, a portion of his works.
